## About
OC Steering Columns works on one thing: automotive steering columns. From our shop on Enterprise St. in Orange, we rebuild worn and broken columns, build custom columns, and carry hard to find remanufactured and used columns for domestic cars, trucks and vans.
That includes Chevrolet, Buick, Cadillac, Pontiac, Oldsmobile, GMC, Dodge, Ford and Jeep, plus step vans, food trucks, walk-in delivery vans and motorhomes. We also repair steering columns on cranes and tractors.
When you call, ask for Felipe. Customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 63 Google reviews, and many of them mention older vehicles that other shops would not touch.

## Services
- Rebuild jobs: All parts are cleaned, painted surfaces are recoated in OEM style semi-gloss black, friction points are lubricated, and certain key parts are replaced with new ones. Final price depends on time and parts. (From $250)
- Mobile steering column repair service: We come to your location in Orange County, Los Angeles County and the Inland Empire, so you don't have to tow your vehicle to a shop. Local repair shops can also have us pick up the column, fix it and deliver it back.
- Send us your old column: Can't find a replacement? Ship us your old broken column for a full rebuild and we will send it back in a few days. It does not matter how damaged it is, as long as it is complete.
- Custom made OEM steering columns: Tilt, telescopic, automatic, standard, floor shift, column shift, key in the column or key in the dash. Give us your measurements and we will help you figure out the best column for your vehicle.
- Remanufactured and used steering columns: Hard to find columns for domestic cars, trucks, vans, step vans and motorhomes.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open every day from 10 AM to 8 PM.

Q: Do you ship out of state?
A: Yes. We ship all over the United States, including Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.

Q: My column is badly damaged. Can you still rebuild it?
A: Most likely. How damaged it is doesn't matter, as long as the column is complete.

Q: Do you work on cranes and tractors?
A: Yes. We repair steering columns on Steiger, Versatile and Case tractors, Link Belt and many other types of cranes. Call for a quote.

Q: Do you sell Chinese aftermarket columns?
A: No. We don't sell or recommend them. The quality is poor and their parts do not interchange with OEM columns, so they are hard to repair later.
